game.name: Fifa 08 (Asia)
game.desc: EA is releasing its 2008 version of its flagship football licence FIFA on Xbox 360. The title features 620 teams, 30 leagues and over 15,000 licensed players. Train offline before taking on your opponents in online leagues. Participate in numerous tournaments, improve your skills with training and monitor the transfer market. Get into heated games with friends and become the king of the game.
